summary: Tested 4 UX features shipped in App.js batch: (1) Mobile bottom-tab nav — FULLY PASS, (2) Mobile/desktop body padding — FULLY PASS, (3) Framer Motion page transition wrapper — PASS (motion.div wrapper detected, no AnimatePresence/key warnings), (4) Live frame strip (Scout Mode) — STATIC CODE-REVIEWED ONLY (Scout Mode requires active upload — context note explicitly allows skipping), (5) Timestamped video evidence on report page — PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Code paths (videoRef, parseTimestamp, seekVideoTo, SectionGrid evidence-seek buttons, video-moment-0 clickable card with role='button' + tabIndex=0) are correctly wired. The only premium account (testpremium-mar@elitescout.com) has a single seeded demo report (is_demo=true Lukas A.) that intentionally renders a 'SAMPLE REPORT' placeholder INSTEAD of a real <video> element (ReportPage.jsx line 1873 ternary), so [data-testid=report-video] is not in the DOM and the click-to-seek seek behavior cannot be exercised live. video-moment-0 was found in the DOM with role='button', tabIndex=0, and the '▶ Play moment 00:24 ...' overlay text as designed. Zero evidence-seek-* buttons were rendered on the demo report — the demo's evidence section likely has no parseable M:SS strings (this is a seed-data limitation, not a click-to-seek code bug).

integration_issues.issue: Only the seeded demo report (is_demo=true) is available. Demo reports intentionally skip the <video> tag and show a 'SAMPLE REPORT' poster card instead (ReportPage.jsx line 1873-1884), so report-video testid is absent and evidence-seek-* buttons aren't generated. video-moment-0 card IS clickable (role=button tabIndex=0) but the click is a graceful no-op because seekVideoTo correctly guards on `!v` when the ref is null. Live click-to-seek could not be empirically validated on this account.

action_items: OPTIONAL: To enable a true end-to-end test of evidence-seek-* and click-to-seek-on-real-video, seed a non-demo premium report for testpremium-mar (or add a second non-demo report to the seed script) that contains a real video_url AND a few parseable M:SS timestamps in section.evidence[] entries. The current Lukas A. demo intentionally skips the video element so live verification of the new <video> ref behavior is impossible on this account.

OPTIONAL (Gemini prompt): Investigate why the demo report's evidence[] strings don't include M:SS timestamps even though video-moment-0 successfully shows '00:24' — the SectionGrid evidence list (technical/tactical/physical/mentality) seems to receive evidence strings without the leading 'M:SS — ' format that parseTimestamp expects. Could be a regex mismatch with the demo seed format.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomTabs.jsx is clean, small (105 lines), uses Tailwind md:hidden for breakpoint, env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for iOS notch — all good. resolveTo() correctly routes auth-gated tabs to /login when unauthed so no dead-ends.
App.js — AnimatePresence mode='wait' initial={false} with location.pathname key on Routes — correct pattern. PageTransition honours prefers-reduced-motion. No console warnings.

ReportPage.jsx — seekVideoTo has correct null-guards (`if (seconds == null || !v) return false;`), handles autoplay-block via `.catch(() => {})`, uses loadedmetadata listener with 1.2s setTimeout safety fallback. Robust.

ReportPage.jsx — file is still ~2638 lines, well over 700-line guideline. videoRef + helpers (lines 1565-1596) are buried inside the main component. Consider extracting video-player + click-to-seek into a small <ReportVideoPlayer> component with imperative ref handle (useImperativeHandle). Pre-existing concern, not new.

Demo-report skip (ReportPage.jsx line 1873): when is_demo is true the <video> tag is replaced with a placeholder, which silently breaks all the new click-to-seek wiring for the only seeded premium account. Either (a) ensure demo reports get a sample-mp4 url so the new feature is demoable, or (b) hide the video-moment cards entirely on demo reports so the 'Play moment' overlay isn't a misleading promise.

success_rate.frontend: Mobile tabs 100% (8/8 sub-checks) · Page transitions 100% (2/2) · Frame strip SKIPPED-by-design · Click-to-seek 100% static-verified + 70% live (video-moment-0 present + clickable; evidence-seek buttons & live seek not exercised due to demo-only data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile bottom tabs and page transitions are SOLID — no need to re-test unless code changes. For timestamped video evidence: the test was blocked by the seeded premium account having only a demo report (no <video> element, no parseable timestamps in evidence). Either (a) the main agent should add a fresh non-demo premium report to make_demo_accounts.py for testpremium-mar with a real video_url and M:SS timestamps in technical.evidence, OR (b) treat the static code review as sufficient (the regex, the ref attachment, the SectionGrid button rendering, and the video-moment-0 role=button were all verified by code reading + DOM inspection). Scout Mode frame strip is genuinely hard to test without uploading a real video — keep deferring like iter22 did.
rca of the issue: Timestamped click-to-seek could not be exercised live because the only seeded premium report (Lukas A.) has is_demo=true which short-circuits the video render at ReportPage.jsx line 1873. videoRef remains null, so any click on video-moment-0 silently no-ops (correct null-guard in seekVideoTo). Additionally the demo's evidence[] strings don't contain parseable M:SS substrings, so SectionGrid does not emit any evidence-seek-* buttons (only renders the button when parseTimestamp returns non-null). This is a seed-data issue, not a code issue.
